name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 7 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-04-29, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
